---
title: "open-company-uk"
---

An open, reproducible pipeline for deriving transparent company-status, compliance, and
ownership indicators from free UK Companies House data.

This is methodology, not a company-rating product. Register records cannot establish that a
company is trustworthy, solvent, or non-fraudulent. The pipeline produces traceable
attributes and discrete flags, never a composite score, and publishes no named company
results or personal data.

- [Methodology](methodology.qmd) explains the pipeline, evidence tiers, and severity semantics.
- [Validation](validation.qmd) describes the positive-unlabelled study design.
- [Limitations](limitations.qmd) states what the data and method cannot show.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Companies House or the Insolvency Service. Contains public
sector information from both bodies licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
